name: Kaitou Yasoukyoku ~Phantom Nocturne~
original_name: 怪盗夜想曲～ファントムノクターン～
source:
A game of thievery, training, and romance!

A café master by day.
A sexy female phantom thief by night.

With fellow good-looking phantom thieves, collect treasures from all over the world!

一场盗窃、训练和浪漫的游戏！

与帅气的怪盗伙伴们一起，收集世界各地的宝藏！
